title: Design: the export error messages look like the other reports' errors
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has more than 2,000 open A/P lines.
    For example: the QA organization (13,540).
  • You can switch this computer's network connection off and on (for example Wi-Fi).
  • Starting screen: A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Download the PDF from the ⋯ menu and read the message, letter for letter.
  2. Look at its style and position.
  3. Switch the network connection off.
  4. Choose "Download (CSV)" from the ⋯ menu and read the message, letter for letter.
  5. Switch the network back on.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again."
  • Step 2: an error toast, as on the other reports, and only one.
  • Step 3: the computer is offline.
  • Step 4: "We couldn't export this report. Please try again.", an error toast, only one.
  • Step 5: the connection is back.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11533 (Story 3, Export to PDF and CSV)

  • User Feedback Summary: “PDF export over 2,000 rows | "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." | Error toast, as on the other reports; nothing downloads”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Export fails for any other reason | "We couldn't export this report. Please try again." | Error toast; nothing downloads; these six reports only”
  • S3-N1: “Over 2,000 rows, the PDF is refused before anything is generated: no download, and the message "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." Exactly 2,000 rows is allowed.”
  • Story 3, Error Handling: “If an export fails for any other reason (a server error or a lost connection), nothing downloads and one error message shows: "We couldn't export this report. Please try again." This message is on these six reports only; the other reports keep theirs.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
